patthana23.14:1.1: na kusalaṃ na micchattaniyataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo micchattaniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.14:2.1: na kusalaṃ na sammattaniyataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo sammattaniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.14:3.1: na kusalaṃ na aniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato aniyato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā pañca. nakusalattika namaggārammaṇattike kusalattika maggārammaṇattikaṃ
